name: Yoda OG
summary: **Yoda OG** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:DNA Genetics]], crossing [[og-kush|OG Kush]] and [[master-kush|Master Kush]]. It won first place at the 2012 High Times Los Angeles Cannabis Cup.
